name: Family Meeting
hook: So, um, Mom, Dad… about the college fund
tagline: A kitchen table, a casserole, a cross on the wall. The daughter with the rainbow hair has something to tell her parents: the college fund is in a dog coin, and every step up the multiplier gets closer to the church fund while their faces go red, the pearls get clutched and the kettle joins in. Take profits and send her to her room before both of their heads explode.
